title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 138
description: Ten questions on Psalms 138: wholehearted thanks, Yahweh who answers, looks after the lowly and saves with his right hand.

questions.text: With what will the psalmist give thanks to Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Psalms 138:1 says, "I will give you thanks with my whole heart."

questions.text: Before whom will he sing praises?
questions.explanation: Psalms 138:1 says, "Before the gods, I will sing praises to you."

questions.text: Toward what will he bow down?
questions.explanation: Psalms 138:2 says, "I will bow down toward your holy temple."

questions.text: What has Yahweh exalted above all, according to verse 2?
questions.explanation: Psalms 138:2 says, "you have exalted your Name and your Word above all."

questions.text: What happened in the day that he called?
questions.explanation: Psalms 138:3 says, "In the day that I called, you answered me."

questions.text: Who will give thanks to Yahweh, according to verse 4?
questions.explanation: Psalms 138:4 says all the kings of the earth will give him thanks.

answers.text: Only the priests of the temple
All the kings of the earth

questions.text: Why will the kings of the earth give thanks?
questions.explanation: Psalms 138:4 says they will give thanks because they have heard the words of Yahweh's mouth.

answers.text: They have heard the words of his mouth

questions.text: Though Yahweh is high, whom does he look after?
questions.explanation: Psalms 138:6 says, "though Yahweh is high, yet he looks after the lowly."

questions.text: What will Yahweh do though the psalmist walks in the middle of trouble?
questions.explanation: Psalms 138:7 says, "Though I walk in the middle of trouble, you will revive me."

questions.text: What does the psalmist ask Yahweh not to forsake?
questions.explanation: Psalms 138:8 says, "Don't forsake the works of your own hands."

answers.text: The works of his own hands
